positions.title: Optical Engineer
positions.description:
Lumeras is an early stage technology company that develops, markets, and manufactures laser sources (IR to vacuum-UV wavelengths) for materials characterization, photolithographic metrology, mass spectrometry, and chemical and biological analysis, screening, and detection.

Key roles:
 
-As a graduate student, worked on the initial prototype laser as a user to take data and determine product viability. The results of these experiments were published in Review of Scientific Instruments (Rev. Sci. Instr. 87, 011301 (2016)), leading to worldwide product sales to research groups. 

-Manufacturing, optical characterization and modelling, and on-site installation/technical support for Lumeras laser products.

-Continuing product development to improve repetition rate, reliability, pulse width, and output power.

-Continuing application development for VUV lasers.

positions.title: Ph.D-Applied physics
positions.description:
Ph. D. Advisor: Professor Zhi-Xun Shen

Experimental condensed matter physics, with focus on electronic materials. 

Thin film growth of superconductors, topological insulators, combined with in-situ study of their electronic properties. Primary techniques include ultra-high vacuum, molecular beam epitaxy, angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy, x-ray scattering and absorption techniques.

Design and prototyping of ultra-high vacuum chambers and spectroscopy instrumentation. 

Development of vacuum ultraviolet lasers.

positions.title: Research Associate - Memristors
positions.description:
Memristors are a novel type of non-volatile memory technology which have promising applications in
advanced computation; devices may be faster and more efficient compared to conventional RAM and flash.

Researched selectors, a critical component of memristive devices.  Analyzed devices across three phases: unformed, forming, and formed. Developed forming protocols and studied selector IV characteristics vs temperature, composition and dimension. Refined physical models of selector devices, with results published in Appl. Phys. Lett. 108, 023505 (2016).

Integrated measurement setup with automatic data storage and analysis using Labview, Python, and MySQL to speed up wafer analysis over large numbers of devices (>100).
